entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to make a return, I think. I'm just so confused by the website. My order number is... uh... VF88712.
I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up order VF88712. I see you purchased the VeloFit Kinetic cycling shoes. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?

Oh, they just... they hurt my feet. I think maybe I installed the cleats wrong, I'm not sure. I keep getting terrible blisters after every ride. I just don't understand what I'm doing wrong. Can't you just help me?
I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters, that definitely shouldn't be happening. I see here that you received the shoes about 84 days ago. Let me just check our policy for you.
Eighty-four days? Oh no, I knew it was too late. I just get so overwhelmed with these things.
Not at all. For our standard items like these cycling shoes, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely process a return for you and get you a full refund.
Wait, really? I can still get a refund? Oh, that's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you!

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return process and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the shoes in their original box, apply the label, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be issued.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much for making it so easy, David.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
